tests.title: column edits preserve opaque board references, shared borders, history and native files @production
column edits preserve opaque board references, shared borders, history and native files @production

fixture: Synthetic 2x2 square board with opaque cell/vertex/edge IDs, explicit cell indices, a rotated boundary list, pink lower-left shade, clue 17, blue bottom edge and green shared edge.
scope: Columns 2 to 3: retain all original vertices, annotations, Undo/Redo and file reload. Paint a newly added cell with desktop mouse / native mobile touch. Columns 3 to 1: remove that paint but retain the shared edge, original shade and clue, including reload. Unit coverage additionally checks margins, exclusions, trials and no deleted-ID reuse.
